A20:refuse_elytra_jump_in_air.skip: Null refuses on purpose: a jump in the air with an elytra worn would send a PlayerCommand to start gliding in a vanilla client; the fork models no gliding, so it refuses on the client and sends nothing (patch 34, F5 §4.6).

A20:refuse_riptide_in_water.skip: Null refuses on purpose: a Riptide trident used standing in water would launch a vanilla client and send UseItem and PlayerAction; the fork models no riptide movement, so it refuses and sends nothing (patch 34, F5 §4.6).

A20:refuse_use_effects_speed.skip: Null refuses on purpose: an item whose use_effects change the use speed is eaten by a vanilla client (UseItem, a meal); the fork refuses it and sends no UseItem (patch 34, F5 §4.6).

A20:refuse_mount_boat.skip: Null refuses on purpose: a right-click on a boat mounts it in a vanilla client (Interact packets, then the ride); the fork refuses with WouldMount and sends no Interact (patch 34, F5 §4.6).
